name: researcher-research-plan → researcher-research-gather (fan-out)
description: ADR-042 §Phase 2 redesign + ADR-046 Phase 1 fan-out + ADR-060 §7 (#272) containment ceiling. Fires when the plan-phase researcher terminates with decide(action=gather, subtopics=[...]) carrying 1..4 subtopics. The decide tool stamps coordinator.decision.subtopics as a JSON-encoded list triple on the planner's loop entity (after researchdecide enforces minItems=1/maxItems=4 pre-mutation); this rule gates on a 1..4 element JSON string-array regex as defense-in-depth and uses for_each over that list to spawn ONE researcher-research-gather per subtopic, in parallel. Each spawned gatherer carries $subtopic in its prompt and properties as its scope. The join half lives in rule 03a (stamp completion on parent) + rule 03b (synthesize when all complete). N=1 (non-decomposable prompt) degenerates to a single sequential gatherer — first-class case, not a special path.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-research-gather
on_enter.prompt:
GATHER phase entry — fan-out from PLAN. The plan-phase researcher at loop $entity.instance handed off with decide(action="gather", subtopics=[...]). The framework spawned one gatherer per subtopic in parallel; YOU are scoped to one subtopic:

**Your subtopic:** $subtopic

That string IS your scope. Investigate only what it names — your N-1 sibling gatherers are working their own subtopics concurrently. Call read_loop_result on $entity.instance (the plan loop) for situational awareness (goal, context, full subtopics list), but do NOT expand your assignment beyond your subtopic.

When your subtopic targets a configured portfolio program, project, or repository, use github_read (channel="github", source_class="primary") to read issues, pull_requests, releases, commits, and ci_status. For external web sources, use web_search to discover candidate sources and bash + curl to fetch specific URLs when snippet results are insufficient. Accumulate findings in scratchpad per researcher-research-gather/20-iteration-rules.md.

Terminate with decide(action="synthesize", reason="Subtopic: $subtopic\n\n<your subtopic findings — per-actor evidence, per-boundary observations, any open gaps>") when your subtopic is grounded. Open the reason with the literal 'Subtopic: $subtopic' line so SYNTHESIZE's aggregator can index your contribution. OR decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="github_read / web_search + bash could not resolve subtopic '$subtopic' — <specific reason>") when external evidence is structurally insufficient for your subtopic.

metadata.iteration_budget_note: 20 allows scoped searches, source reads, scratchpad updates, and the terminal decision for each fan-out child. Conservative engineering defaults, not successful-completion guarantees.
metadata.fan_out: for_each over $entity.triple.coordinator.decision.subtopics — one gatherer per subtopic in parallel. JOIN happens at rules 03a (per-completion stamp) + 03b (length_eq synthesize trigger).
metadata.tool_choice_rationale: Required-mode forces gemini-flash to emit a tool call every iteration; decide is in the tools list, so the loop terminates via decide(synthesize|needs_clarification) — populating Result with the synthesis-ready reason. Without it, text-only completions strand the LLM's prose output (framework Result field is exclusively populated by tool returns; #133 synthetic-decide doesn't fire on this path). Surfaced by smoke #fan-out-validation-2 2026-05-29: 2 of 3 parallel gemini-flash gathers terminated text-only at 219+ tokens, all stranded. Beta.80 #132 documented pattern.
metadata.supersedes_legacy: configs/rules/research-mode-transition/04-phase-transition-to-gather.json — same forward edge, now fan-out instead of single dispatch.
